nodes.title: Developer
nodes.description: Browses architecture maps, from the landscape down to a single file.

nodes.title: Mapping agent
nodes.description: An AI agent following the map-repo skill: reads the graph and the code, writes the map.

nodes.title: Mapped repository
nodes.description: The codebase being mapped; only ever read, on the project's side.

nodes.title: Mapper
nodes.description: Runs beside the mapped project: turns it into a bundle (the file graph from code, the map from the agent) and uploads it to the viewer service.

nodes.title: File graph
nodes.description: Application files reached from entry points, and the references between them, in JS/TS, C#, Rust and Java.

nodes.title: Map bundling
nodes.description: Checks a map against the graph and builds the bundle: the viewer model and every shown file's source; also extracts the LikeC4 samples.

nodes.title: Request flows
nodes.description: Reads each backend endpoint and the path its requests take, and builds the Requests view from them.

nodes.title: Test traces
nodes.description: Runs a project's own end-to-end tests with an OpenTelemetry agent attached, receives the spans, and marks what ran: endpoints, files, store links, tables, the pages a browser made each request from and the tests that made it.

nodes.title: Agent commands
nodes.description: graph, check, audit, trace, publish (with --watch for live, --trace for what tests ran) and pull: small commands for agents.

nodes.title: Viewer service
nodes.description: Takes uploaded bundles, keeps them, and serves the models and sources the viewer opens, with what changed since the upload before; it never reads a mapped project.

nodes.title: Viewer
nodes.description: The zoomable map: fly from the whole landscape into any element, with relations, routes and lenses.

nodes.title: App shell
nodes.description: Loads a model, runs the frame loop, swaps live updates in, keeps the place in the address, and shows the HUD, details panel (with the map's endpoints), code reader and model tabs.

nodes.title: Model
nodes.description: The element tree with relations rolled up per level, synthetic landscapes, the diff that lets a new version morph in place, and what changed since the upload before.

nodes.title: Layout and routing
nodes.description: Packs each container's children in worker threads and routes edges through the gutters between cards.

nodes.title: Rendering
nodes.description: Draws only what the camera sees at its zoom, with lenses (size, coupling, churn).

nodes.title: Code view
nodes.description: Past a file card, its own source: a minimap first, then coloured, readable lines with the graph's marked and cited lines.

nodes.title: Video recorder
nodes.description: A second page that encodes frames sent by the recording script into a video with WebCodecs.

nodes.title: Controls
nodes.description: The controls: search, Back and Parent, stepping through a selection's relations, a context menu and the minimap.

features.title: Requests view: endpoints and their paths
